caption: The drawing features a symmetrical composition with a central monument that has a triangular top and an oval portrait of a person with white hair, wearing a beige coat with blue trim. Below the portrait, the inscription "G. WASHINGTON" is written. The monument stands on a blue and beige plinth adorned with a square shape, a circular symbol with spokes, and geometric decorations. Flanking the monument are two tall columns decorated with vertical blue and beige stripes, pink flowers, and Corinthian capitals, standing on a floor with a checked black and brown pattern. On either side of the columns, there are urns on small plinths holding stylized, arching floral branches with blue leaves and multiple pink flowers that curve and meet at the top center, forming an arch. The background is a flat ochre color, while the edges and architectural elements predominantly use blue, beige, pink, and white tones. The top of the composition features blue drapery with a pink scalloped edge, and the artist's signature "Ewing" is present in the lower right corner.
title: Wall Paper and Border
